selection: Every selected mechanism first completes one real original total-time/size screen. Native/model counts cannot alone eliminate. Select for fresh confirmation using per-block latest-snapshot share and axes, including parent/shadow disagreements; proof gate is a separate obligation.
freeze: Exact Rust and Lean files recorded before confirmation; any later code/proof mutation needs new binding and new independent confirmation.
confirmation: Two new GitHub runner jobs, two original11rep blocks each, parent plus same-source parent and candidate controls; reversed or interleaved candidate order recorded before launch. Discovery is excluded from independent summary.
classification: Only describe observed stable positive projection when primary and shadow calibration plus candidate-copy observations remain positive across the frozen independent runs, fullgate passed, and no contradictory block hidden. Report min/median/best/range, zeros,>=5/>=10 counts, per runner and role. Sample counts are not formal probabilities. No claim of formal admission/payment.
conditional_gate_parallelism: May run confirmation on an already frozen exact pair while its fullgate runs; its actual gate status remains UNKNOWN until receipt. If proof changes, previous pair runs are not final-pair confirmation.
not_a_fixed_success_threshold: Positive cross-runner observation is an intermediate reliability result, not proof of permanent reward or completion of5/10long-term goals.
